mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% (from below), S&P 500 20-day forward returns turn negative.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 2% and UNRATE exceeds 5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns turn negative.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such conditions are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a 1-month decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in expanding demand periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE crosses below 4% (from above), S&P 500 60-day forward returns turn positive.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 18-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and UNRATE exceeds 6%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns turn negative.
failure_condition: 5-day returns in such conditions are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a 2-month increase in INDPRO (supply) predicts positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery, 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 24-month window.
